s.en: start a process as a new D-Bus session

syn: dbus-run-session [--config-file FILENAME] [--dbus-daemon BINARY] [--] PROGRAM [ARGUMENTS...] ⏎ dbus-run-session --help ⏎ dbus-run-session --version

o.en: Pass --config-file=FILENAME to the bus daemon, instead of passing it the --session argument. See dbus-daemon(1).
Run BINARY as dbus-daemon(1), instead of searching the PATH in the usual way for an executable called dbus-daemon.
Print the version of dbus-run-session and exit.
